definitions: Any of the more or less distinct parts into which something is or may be divided or from which it is made up.
A distinct group within a larger body of people or things.
A part of a book, newspaper, or other document.
A part of a city or country.
A small segment of a larger whole, often used for analysis or display.
examples: The business section of the newspaper.
The children's section of the library.
The section of the brain responsible for memory.
The new housing section of the city.
A cross-section of the plant stem.
